items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of parking exemption
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diese Entscheidung können Sie binnen eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe beim Bezirksamt Beispielfleet, Fleetplatz 3, 21073 Hamburg, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift einlegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 06.11.2026, sent by regular post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (Bekanntgabefiktion), a letter sent by post within Germany is deemed delivered on the third day after posting, counting the day of posting as day zero: day 1 = Sat 07.11., day 2 = Sun 08.11., day 3 = Mon 09.11.2026. Since this third day (09.11.2026) itself is a regular business day (not Sat/Sun/holiday), no further shift is needed, so Bekanntgabe = 09.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe is not counted, the period starts 10.11.2026, and one month later ends on the day of the following month numerically corresponding to the triggering day, i.e. 09.12.2026 (Wednesday). 09.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or Hamburg public holiday, so the deadline stands. Note: this computation assumes the letter was actually posted on its printed date (06.11.2026); if postal dispatch was later, the deadline shifts accordingly.
